bugs.summary: splitAmount drops the remainder: shares don't add up to cents
monthKey uses getUTCMonth() as 1-based, so January is 00
escapeHtml replaces & after < and >, double-escaping them (< becomes &lt;)
isEmail's regex has no $ anchor, so trailing text is accepted
TtlCache.get multiplies ttlMs by 1000, so entries live 1000 times too long
hitCount returns undefined instead of 0 for a key that was set but never read
retry runs fn only `retries` times instead of retries + 1 (0 retries never calls fn)
processAll uses forEach with an async callback: it resolves before the work finishes, runs items concurrently and loses rejections
byDateDesc's comparator returns a boolean instead of a number, so the sort order is wrong
nextPage uses >= afterId, so each page repeats the last item of the previous page
cloneRecord uses JSON round-tripping, which turns Date values into strings

decoys.summary: correct: same instant plus n x 24 h, as documented
